With just 7B parameters in its visual generation component (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility. sources.snippet: Qwen Image is a new open-source text-to-image model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team. It's quickly gaining thumbs-up from AI creators. Unlike many closed models, Qwen Image is both flexible and accessible, making it a strong alternative to Stable Diffusion and Flux models. You can run it locally in ComfyUI with customization.
